reason: The PR removes several default local-search operators and their C++ implementations, changes Model.solve and search-module operator exports, and updates the build list. This changes the solver's neighborhood portfolio and candidate-evaluation work, with a possible solution-quality tradeoff.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: A leaner neighborhood portfolio may reduce work per local-search iteration and reach strong incumbents sooner, while removing operators can also prevent improvements on structures those moves uniquely serve.
causal_chain: Model.solve obtains default node and route operator collections; the PR removes several expensive moves from those collections and deletes their implementations. Candidate generation and acceptance can change, so local operator timing alone cannot establish an end-to-end solver gain.
structural_trigger: CVRP or VRPTW instances solved with Model.solve's default local search, where the removed operators were registered before the PR; custom portfolios that never include those moves are controls.
activation_probe: Capture the default operator list and count removed-operator evaluations, accepted moves, local-search iterations, and incumbent trajectories on matched base and PR builds.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze visible and hidden routing families by size, capacity tightness, and time-window structure before hidden scoring; retain custom-portfolio controls, all seeds, and every regression or timeout.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared PyVRP driver and independent original-route verifier. Confirm the pinned historical Model.solve path registers the removed operators on development cases before promoting this PR beyond source verification.
mathematical_risk: Changed operator exports or move portfolios can miss feasible improving routes, alter fixed-cost or time-window handling, and return a worse or invalid incumbent; the full source-only patch must be checked against original instances.
independent_check_plan: Check route coverage, capacity, time windows, fleet use, and objective values against original instances; compare complete paired trajectories and targeted local-search regressions.
hidden_generalization_plan: Report verified incumbent quality, time-to-target, and per-family regressions on held-out CVRP and time-window routing structures under matched seeds and budgets.
overlap_review: This 2024 operator-portfolio removal is a separate historical state from #376's 2023 move-evaluation changes and the later PyVRP ILS tasks. One merged PR counts once despite multiple deleted operators.
resource_risk: Fewer operators may lower CPU and binary size but worsen generalization if a removed move is uniquely effective on held-out routing structures.
